verified_conclusion: Every metric-bearing domain the phase brief lists (Optimization, Forecasting, Resilience, Risk) is owned by a real, verified specialist module. The KPI layer introduced in Phase 9.1 computes exactly one new thing: generic scenario-vs-baseline deltas for metrics the Digital Twin's existing comparison mechanism does not already cover (risk_factor), using the same NOT_COMPARABLE-on-missing-data pattern already proven there. Everything else is a verbatim wrap.
